name: 43228 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43228 (Columbus) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43228 (Columbus) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 43228 (Columbus) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
